title: Micron held a sole-U.S.-based HBM manufacturing position
canonical_summary: Two reports described Micron as the only U.S.-based high-bandwidth-memory manufacturer, an ongoing supply-chain position distinct from individual HBM4 shipment milestones.
known_event_summary: August 27-28, 2026 Micron position: Micron was described as the sole U.S.-based manufacturer of high-bandwidth memory.

facts.proposition: Micron was described as the sole U.S.-based manufacturer of high-bandwidth memory.
